notes.title: Touhou Multi Scroll Shooting is Free to play.
notes.notes:
I have changed from paid game to free game. People can access to this game without a hesitation.

Thank you for playing my game.

And stay tune for Touhou Multi Sroll Shooting 2.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1480040/Touhou_Multi_Scroll_Shooting_2/

notes.title: We have a plan to change this game from paid game to free game.
notes.notes:
I want more people can access to this game.
I intend to set a price to be 0 on late February 2021.

notes.title: Update to version 1.15
notes.notes:
Change player oblique movement speed scale from (1,1) to (0.707,0.707)
Increase invincible time after player has taken damage from 1.5 seconds to 2.1 seconds.

notes.title: Update to version 1.14
notes.notes:
Changed anti alias method from Temporal AA to FXAA. Circle bullets should be actual circle shape.
Fixed glitch player's shoot too frequent by spamming shot button.

notes.title: Demo of Touhou Multi Scroll Shooting 2 is available on Steam.
Update to version 1.13
notes.notes:
Fixed bug stage2 boss's helpers are not displayed.
Fixed character's proportion.

notes.title: Update to version 1.12
notes.notes:
Fixed glitch players can toggle pause menu after ran out of Hp.
After this update, players cannot toggle pause menu when game over.

notes.title: Version 1.11 is available.
notes.notes: Hard mode and Normal mode are easier than previous versions.

- Bug Ex stage clear before all boss are killed should be fixed.
- Bug stage 2 boss move around during phase 3 should be fixed.
